<template>
  <el-dialog
      v-model="dialogVisible"
      title="删除防火墙规则"
      width="800px"
      @close="rules = []"
  >
    <!-- 容器选择 -->
    <el-form :inline="true" class="mb-4">
      <el-form-item label="容器名称" required>
        <el-select v-model="containerName" placeholder="选择容器" style="width: 240px">
          <el-option
              v-for="(container, index) in containers"
              :key="index"
              :label="container.name.replace(/^\//, '')"
              :value="container.name.replace(/^\//, '')"
          />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>

      <el-form-item label="链名称" required>
        <el-select v-model="chain" placeholder="选择链" style="width: 160px">
          <el-option label="INPUT" value="INPUT" />
          <el-option label="OUTPUT" value="OUTPUT" />
          <el-option label="FORWARD" value="FORWARD" />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>

      <el-form-item>
        <el-button type="primary" @click="handleViewRules">查看</el-button>
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <!-- 表格展示 -->
    <el-table :data="rules" v-loading="loading" style="width: 100%">
      <!-- 删除按钮列 -->
      <el-table-column label="操作" width="100">
        <template #default="scope">
          <el-button type="danger" size="small" @click="handleDelete(scope.$index)">删除</el-button>
        </template>
      </el-table-column>

      <!-- 索引列 -->
      <el-table-column label="#" type="index" width="50" />

      <!-- 动态表头 -->
      <el-table-column
          v-for="(header, idx) in headers"
          :key="idx"
          :prop="'field' + idx"
          :label="header"
      />
    </el-table>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false">关闭</el-button>
    </template>

    <DockerContainers ref="containersRef" style="display: none" />
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, defineExpose, nextTick } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage, ElMessageBox } from 'element-plus'
import DockerContainers from '@/components/Container/DockerContainers.vue'

const dialogVisible = ref(false)
const containerName = ref('')
const chain = ref('')
const rules = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)
const containers = ref([])
const containersRef = ref(null)
const headers = ref([])

// 打开弹窗并初始化
const openDialog = async () => {
  dialogVisible.value = true
  containerName.value = ''
  chain.value = ''
  await nextTick()
  if (containersRef.value) {
    await containersRef.value.fetchContainers()
    containers.value = containersRef.value.containers || []
  }
}
defineExpose({ openDialog })

// 查看规则逻辑
const handleViewRules = async () => {
  if (!containerName.value) {
    ElMessage.warning('请选择容器')
    return
  }

  loading.value = true
  try {
    const response = await axios.get('http://localhost:8081/firewall/list', {
      params: {
        containerName: containerName.value,
        chain: chain.value,
      },
    })

    const lines = response.data
        .split('\n')
        .map(line => line.trim())
        .filter(line => line.length > 0)

    if (lines.length < 2) {
      rules.value = []
      headers.value = []
      return
    }

    // 提取表头
    const headerLine = lines[1]
    headers.value = headerLine.split(/\s+/)

    // 提取数据行
    const ruleLines = lines.slice(2)
    rules.value = ruleLines.map(line => {
      const parts = line.split(/\s+/)
      const obj = {}
      parts.forEach((p, idx) => {
        obj[`field${idx}`] = p
      })
      return obj
    })

  } catch (err) {
    ElMessage.error(`获取规则失败：${err?.response?.data || err.message}`)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

// 删除规则
const handleDelete = async (index) => {
  try {
    await ElMessageBox.confirm(
        `确定要删除序号为 ${index} 的规则吗？`,
        '确认删除',
        {
          confirmButtonText: '确认',
          cancelButtonText: '取消',
          type: 'warning',
          distinguishCancelAndClose: true,
          center: false,
          customClass: 'custom-message-box',
          confirmButtonClass: 'el-button--primary order-1',
          cancelButtonClass: 'el-button--default order-2',
        }
    )

    await axios.delete('http://localhost:8081/firewall/deleteByIndex', {
      params: {
        containerName: containerName.value,
        chain: chain.value,
        index,
      },
    })
    ElMessage.success('规则删除成功')
    handleViewRules()

  } catch (err) {
    if (err !== 'cancel') {
      ElMessage.error(`删除失败：${err?.response?.data || err.message}`)
    }
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.mb-4 {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
</style>
